# ZeroSmokeWay

> A short film about the nicotine trap, then a live talk. Not a quit-smoking coach.

ZeroSmokeWay is a mobile cinematic path. Each scene is a short film (a fairy-tale image of why people keep smoking). After the film, Meta Muse Spark talks with the player. It does not lecture and does not run a questionnaire. It stays with their words and decides whether to hold, probe, or open the next scene.

People do not keep smoking because they lack facts. They keep a private story (“I can stop whenever I want”, “it calms me”). This project makes that story visible.

It is not medical advice. Effectiveness for quitting has not been tested with participants.

## Pages

- [Play](https://zerosmokeway.vercel.app/): the film and the talk. Starts at Act 1, Scene 1 — Garden of the Pitcher Plant.
- [About](https://zerosmokeway.vercel.app/about.html): what it is, what it is not, and how a scene works.
- [Source](https://github.com/mshaim001-hue/ZeroSmokeWay): public repository.

## What a scene is

1. A photoreal short film. No on-screen slogan.
2. Full-screen chat. Muse speaks first.
3. The server, not the client, decides if the next scene may open (`hold` / `probe` / `release` / `advance`).

## Optional

- Allen Carr’s Easyway is an influence (the trap is in the head, not a lack of willpower). This is not an official Carr product.
- Dialogue model: Meta Muse Spark (`muse-spark-1.3`).
